newsitem.title: FRANCE: SIDO raises French 96/97 soybean imports forecast.
newsitem.headline: SIDO raises French 96/97 soybean imports forecast.

text.p: French oilseeds and protein seeds association SIDO raised its estimate for 1996/97 soybean imports to 750,000 tonnes from a November target of 680,000 and 590,000 tonnes in 1995/96.
In its January report SIDO put imports from non-EU countries at 720,000 tonnes against 650,000 in November and 556,000 in 1995/96.
It also raised its estimate for 1996/97 crushings to 600,000 tonnes from 530,000 forecast in November and 512,000 achieved in 1995/96.
SIDO kept its estimate for the 1996 soybean crop unchanged from November at 240,000 tonnes.
This would represent a fall of eight percent from the 260,000 harvested in 1995.
It also kept its estimate for carryover stocks at end June 1997 unchanged from November at 51,000 tonnes.
This would compare with a carryover of 31,000 tonnes at end June 1996.
